tagline.en: Eye-strain habit coach & near-work glasses companion
tagline.zh-Hans: 视疲劳习惯教练与近用镜工作流伴侣

shortDescription.en: A wellness habit app for Mac, iPhone and iPad that nudges look-away breaks during work hours and supports dual-pair glasses routines. Not a medical device.
shortDescription.zh-Hans: 面向 Mac / iPhone / iPad 的健康习惯应用：在工作时段提醒远眺，并支持双镜通勤换镜节奏。不是医疗器械。
